title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00022 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
08:15 - 08:30: Performed TBT for skidding rig to f-11 b
08:30 - 08:45: Skidded cantilever to well f-11 b
08:45 - 09:00: Performed post-skid checks.
09:00 - 09:30: Removed hatch. Built scaffolding around hole opening in moonpool. Meanwhile installed deck hatches on well f-12.
09:30 - 09:45: Removed scaffolding on WH deck to access well f-11. Meanwhile changed elevator.
09:45 - 10:15: Lowered and n/u nt2 connector. Installed master bushing.
10:15 - 11:15: P/u and m/u BHA and inner string.
11:15 - 11:30: Engaged multibowl RT to multibowl. Confirmed with 20 ton overpull.
11:30 - 13:30: Load shifted weight from tension cylinders to TDS. N/d tension cylinders and boat collision stool. Built scaffolding around hole opening.
13:30 - 13:45: Staged up flow rate to 2400 LPM 80 bar. Cut riser at 134,9m. Observed loss of overpull, good indication of cut.
13:45 - 14:30: R/d hoses and valve outlets from multibowl. Pulled master bushing.
14:30 - 14:45: Pulled multibowl, riser and inner string to drill floor. Installed master bushing and c-plate. Laned off multibowl onto c-plate.
14:45 - 15:00: M/u TDS and b/o multibowl RT. R/b same.
15:00 - 15:15: R/u false rotary and c-plate.
15:15 - 16:00: POOH with inner string. R/b cutter BHA.
16:00 - 16:15: P/u and m/u mutlibowl RT.
16:15 - 17:00: POOH with riser Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck. Meanwhile performed TBT for l/o multibowl and tensioner joint.
17:00 - 17:15: R/u cutting machine
17:15 - 19:00: Attempted to cut riser. Significant wave height 0,8m observed vibrations after cut a few millimeters into the tensioner joint. Cutter jammed several times.
19:00 - 19:15: Performed TBT with ongoing crew
19:15 - 20:45: Re-aligned cutter and started new cut. Cut riser, vibrations still present. Significant wave height 0,7m. R/d cutting machine.
20:45 - 21:15: L/o multibowl and tensioner joint. Removed multibowl RT and nt2 connector.
21:15 - 21:45: Pulled riser Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck. L
